title: Oven Toasted Chinese Squid Salt And Pepper Squid
description: A malty, crispy, energizing Chinese dish featuring Grand Marnier, candy, and squid, perfect for a dinner or snack, and is egg-free-friendly. This salt and pepper squid recipe is a twist on the classic Chinese dish.

ingredients.name: squid tubes
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cornstarch, salt, and black pepper.
Add the squid pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the cornstarch mixture.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and saute the squid pieces until lightly browned.
Transfer the squid pieces to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the Grand Marnier, malt syrup, and sprinkle the candy melon seeds over the squid pieces.
Bake the squid in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the squid from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the oven toasted Chinese squid salt and pepper squid hot and enjoy.
